name: Bot Meter for X
spokenEnd: Bot Meter for X. On the Chrome Web Store.
audience: people who use X and want to spot spam bots
oneLiner: Shows each account's daily posting rate next to their name on X.
facts: Shows each account's daily posting rate next to their name on X.
Helps you spot spam bots at a glance.
No login or API key needed.
dont: Do not say it blocks, mutes, reports or removes accounts, or that it proves an account is a bot. It shows a posting rate.
angles: replies full of accounts that post all day
telling a busy person from a bot
a number instead of a guess
